title: A difficulty too awkward to disclose
odia: ଅଜାଗା ଘା ଦେଖି ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ କି ଦେଖାଇ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ ।
literal_meaning: A sore in an awkward place can neither be seen nor shown.
explanation: The image conveys a predicament that is hard to inspect privately and embarrassing to disclose. In conversation, it can express the burden of a trouble someone feels unable to explain openly. Its force lies in that double bind, rather than in a recommendation to keep suffering secret.
meaning_odia: ଏମିତି ଅସୁବିଧା ହୋଇଛି ଯାହା ସହିବା କଷ୍ଟ, ଆଉ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ କହିବାକୁ ବି ସଙ୍କୋଚ। ଲୁଚା ଘାଆର ଚିତ୍ର ସେହି ଦ୍ୱିଧାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ। କଥାଟି ମନର ଅସହଜତା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରେ; କଷ୍ଟ ଲୁଚାଇ ରଖିବାକୁ ବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ନମାଗିବାକୁ କହେନାହିଁ।
usage_example: A person asked to mediate a dispute between close relatives feels unable to describe either side’s private complaints. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The bodily image is retained in the literal rendering. The figurative explanation is an editorial reading; no medical claim or origin incident is established.

title: A meal ends; its reputation remains
literal_meaning: One day’s rice; ages of reputation.
explanation: A brief occasion can leave a lasting impression, good or bad. Its memory outlasts the meal.
meaning_odia: ଭୋଜନର ଅବସରଟି ଦିନକର, କିନ୍ତୁ ସେଠାରେ ହୋଇଥିବା ଭଲମନ୍ଦ ବ୍ୟବହାରର ସ୍ମୃତି ବହୁଦିନ ରହିପାରେ। ଆୟୋଜନର ଅବଧି ଓ ତାହାର ପ୍ରଭାବର ଅବଧି ଏକ ନୁହେଁ। ତେଣୁ ସେହି ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସହ କିପରି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଗଲା, ସେ କଥା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ସରିବା ପରେ ବି ମନେ ରହେ।
usage_example: Guests remember a host’s considerate welcome long after the gathering ends. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)

title: Already humiliated
odia: ମୋତେ ମାରନାଁ ମୁଁ ମଲିଣି, ଦୀପ ଲଗେଇ ଦେଖ୍ ପିଠି, ଲାଉ ଚୋର ଭାବ ପାଇଲିଣି
literal_meaning: Do not hit me; I am already dead. Light a lamp and look at my back: I have acquired the name of a gourd thief.
explanation: The dictionary uses this under humiliation: punishment and disgrace have already landed. The protest is not permission for further violence.
meaning_odia: ଦଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଅପମାନ ବହୁତ ସହିସାରିଲିଣି, ଆଉ ନୁହେଁ—ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିବାଦରେ ଏହି କ୍ଷୋଭ ଅଛି। ପିଠି ଦେଖାଇବାର ଚିତ୍ର ସହିଥିବା କଷ୍ଟକୁ ଆଖି ଆଗକୁ ଆଣେ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ଅପମାନର ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ରଖିଛି; ଆଉ ଅଧିକ ହିଂସାକୁ ଏହା ଯଥାର୍ଥ କରେନାହିଁ।
usage_example: A fictional speaker protests against being shamed again. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: No actual theft or punishment incident is verified.

title: A secret concealed inside an ordinary action
odia: ବୁଡ଼ି କରି ପାଣି ପିଇଲେ ମହାଦେବଙ୍କ ବାପା ମଧ୍ୟ ଜାଣି ପରିବେ ନାହିଁ
literal_meaning: If someone drinks water while submerged, even Mahadev’s father will not know.
explanation: The dictionary places this example under doing something secretly. Drinking is hidden within the larger act of being underwater, so an observer cannot easily separate one from the other. The extravagant appeal to Mahadev’s father makes the claim of secrecy comic. It can describe someone’s confidence that a concealed action will escape notice; it does not establish that deception always succeeds.
meaning_odia: ପାଣି ଭିତରେ ବୁଡ଼ିଥିବା ଲୋକ ପାଣି ପିଇଲେ, ବାହାରୁ ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ସେ କାମଟି ଅଲଗା କରି ଜଣାପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ଗୋପନରେ କାମ କରିବାର ଉଦାହରଣ ଭାବେ ଦେଇଛି। ମହାଦେବଙ୍କ ବାପା ବି ଜାଣିପାରିବେ ନାହିଁ କହି କଥାଟି ଲୁଚାଇବାର ଦାବିକୁ ହସରେ ବଢ଼ାଇଦିଏ। ଏଥିରୁ ସବୁ ଲୁଚା କାମ ଚିରକାଳ ଅଜଣା ରହିବ ବୋଲି ନିଶ୍ଚୟ କରିହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
english_summary: The dictionary places this example under doing something secretly.
odia_summary: ପାଣି ଭିତରେ ବୁଡ଼ିଥିବା ଲୋକ ପାଣି ପିଇଲେ, ବାହାରୁ ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ସେ କାମଟି ଅଲଗା କରି ଜଣାପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ।
usage_example: While supposedly tidying a shared desk, someone quietly removes a note and assumes nobody noticed. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: The expression is comic hyperbole, not theological genealogy or an instruction to drink underwater. Source spelling ପରିବେ is retained, not silently changed to ପାରିବେ.

title: Talking oneself out of a welcome meal
odia: ପୁତୁରା ସାଙ୍ଗରେ କଳି କଲି, ମହୁର ତିଅଣରୁ ମେଞ୍ଚାଏ ପାଆନ୍ତି, ତୁଣ୍ଡ ପରସାଦୁଁ ନାଶ ଗଲି
literal_meaning: I quarrelled with my nephew; I might have received a generous portion of mahura curry, but my own mouth spoiled it.
explanation: The speaker looks back on a quarrel and the food they might otherwise have enjoyed. The dictionary defines ମେଞ୍ଚାଏ as a large portion of food. Here the humorous self-accusation turns an abstract consequence of quarrelling into a lost meal: the mouth that wanted food also said the words that cost it. This is a close reading of the example, not a reconstructed family incident.
meaning_odia: ପୁତୁରା ସହ କଳି କରିବା ପରେ କଥକ ମନେ ପକାଉଛନ୍ତି, ନକରିଥିଲେ ମହୁର ତିଅଣରୁ ଭଲ ଭାଗଟିଏ ମିଳିଥାନ୍ତା। ଯେଉଁ ତୁଣ୍ଡ ଖାଇବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲା, ସେହି ତୁଣ୍ଡର କଥା ହିଁ ଖାଇବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ନଷ୍ଟ କଲା—ଏହି ବିରୋଧରେ ହସ ଅଛି। ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ କଳି କରି ନିଜ ସୁବିଧା ବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ ବିଗାଡ଼ିଦେବା ପରେ ଏପରି ନିଜକୁ ନେଇ କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ। ତାହା ବୋଲି ଖାଇବା ବା ସୁବିଧା ପାଇଁ ସବୁ ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ସହିବାକୁ କୁହାଯାଉନାହିଁ।
english_summary: The speaker looks back on a quarrel and the food they might otherwise have enjoyed.
odia_summary: ପୁତୁରା ସହ କଳି କରିବା ପରେ କଥକ ମନେ ପକାଉଛନ୍ତି, ନକରିଥିଲେ ମହୁର ତିଅଣରୁ ଭଲ ଭାଗଟିଏ ମିଳିଥାନ୍ତା।
usage_example: After needlessly snapping at a friend, someone regrets spoiling the relaxed lunch they had planned together. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: Mahura is retained as a named curry; no ingredients, temple recipe or historical household are inferred. The reading concerns needless quarrelling, not an obligation to remain silent about mistreatment.

odia: କହିଲେ କୁଳକୁଟୁମ୍ଭଙ୍କୁ ଲାଜ, ନ କହିଲେ କୁଳ ଭାସି ୟାଉଛି
title: The cost of speaking, the cost of silence
literal_meaning: If I speak, the family is ashamed; if I do not, the family is being swept away.
explanation: Both choices carry a cost. Speaking exposes something embarrassing; remaining silent allows the damage to grow. The image of a family being swept away makes silence seem less safe than it first appears. The saying voices a dilemma, not a command to conceal wrongdoing for the sake of reputation.
meaning_odia: କହିଲେ ପରିବାରର ଲାଜ, ନକହିଲେ ପରିବାରର କ୍ଷତି—ଦୁଇ ପଟେ ଚିନ୍ତା। ଚୁପ୍ ରହିଲେ ମାନ ରହିଯିବ ବୋଲି ଲାଗିପାରେ, ହେଲେ ଭିତରର ଅସୁବିଧା ବଢ଼ୁଥାଏ। କୁଳ ଭାସିଯିବାର ଛବି ସେହି ବିପଦକୁ ତୀବ୍ର କରେ। ଏହା ଦ୍ୱିଧାର କଥା; ପରିବାରର ନାମ ପାଇଁ ଭୁଲ ବା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଲୁଚାଇବାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Protecting a family’s reputation by silence may allow its troubles to deepen.
odia_summary: ପରିବାରର ଲାଜ ବଞ୍ଚାଇବାକୁ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିଲେ କ୍ଷତି ବଢ଼ିପାରେ।
usage_example: A family member discovers mounting unpaid bills and uses the saying while deciding how to begin an uncomfortable but necessary conversation. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: Source defines family and gives the complete dilemma; the bills example is new. No particular household, historical event or duty to hide harm is asserted.

odia: ଷାଠିଏ ବାଟି ନାହାକିଆଣୀ ପରର ବାଡ଼ି ପନ୍ଦାଡ଼ରେ ମାଗି ଖାଉଛି
title: Land and a meal from elsewhere
literal_meaning: The woman with sixty bāṭi of land asks for food at another’s yard or veranda.
explanation: The dictionary defines a woman with extensive landholdings. The quotation sets that description beside asking and eating elsewhere. Our reading notices a gap between an imposing description of possessions and the immediate means of obtaining a meal. It leaves the reason open rather than declaring the woman dishonest or undeserving.
meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ବହୁ ଜମିର ଅଧିକାରିଣୀ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କୁ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। ଉଦ୍ଧୃତି ସେହି ପରିଚୟ ପାଖରେ ପରଘରେ ମାଗି ଖାଇବାକୁ ରଖେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତିର ବଡ଼ ପରିଚୟ ଓ ସେହି ବେଳର ଖାଇବା ଯୋଗାଡ଼ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ ଦିଶେ। ଏହାର କାରଣ ଖୋଲା ରହେ; ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଜଣକ ଠକ ବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟର ଅଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ଆମେ ରାୟ ଦେଉନାହୁଁ।
english_summary: Our reading distinguishes possessions from the meal immediately available.
odia_summary: ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ଓ ସେହି ବେଳର ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଯୋଗାଡ଼କୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: କଥାଟି ପଢ଼ି ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଜମି ଅଛି ବୋଲି ସେହି ବେଳେ ଖାଇବା ଅଛି କି?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ଏଠି କାରଣଟା ଲେଖାନାହିଁ।” / Two readers distinguish owning land from having a meal available and leave the missing explanation unresolved. Their discussion is invented.
cultural_context: The female landowner is the source’s subject. Bāṭi is retained without conversion; the line establishes neither a historical person nor a cause of her request.
